name: RelationshipCanvas
description:
A pannable, zoomable diagram of record cards joined by row-to-row edges. Cards can be
dragged by their header or moved with Shift and the arrow keys, and Auto layout arranges
them; the host keeps the positions through `onPositionsChange`. Selecting a card draws its
edges in the accent. It shows a skeleton while `cards` is undefined.

Keyboard: the arrow keys move to the nearest card in that direction, Shift with an arrow
moves the focused card, Home and End go to the first and last card, Enter opens (or
selects), Space toggles the selection, Escape clears it, + and − zoom and 0 fits.
signature: <T = unknown>({ label, cards, edges, positions: positionsProp, defaultPositions, onPositionsChange, movable, selectedId: selectedIdProp, defaultSelectedId, onSelectedIdChange, onOpen, describeCard, frameKey, controls, grid, framed, emptyText, emptyIcon, actionsRef, className, }: RelationshipCanvasProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: Receives the canvas's commands (zoom, fit, auto layout) for a host toolbar.

props.name: cards
props.description: undefined while loading: the skeleton shows in the same box.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the zoom, fit and Auto layout controls over the canvas. Default true.

props.name: defaultPositions
props.description: Initial positions while uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The card selected at first when the selection is uncontrolled.

props.name: describeCard
props.description: The card's accessible name. Default: its title.

props.name: edges
props.description: Links between rows. Edges to cards or rows that do not exist are skipped (with a development warning).

props.name: emptyIcon
props.description: The empty state's icon. Default a table.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One line for an empty diagram (R2.5).

props.name: framed
props.description: A hairline border and the surface radius around the canvas. Turn it off inside a Panel. Default true.

props.name: frameKey
props.description: Re-fit when this changes (another diagram). Live changes to the same diagram keep the camera.

props.name: grid
props.description: Draw the dot grid; it pans and scales with the camera. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the diagram: "Schema, Active".

props.name: movable
props.description: Cards can be dragged and moved with the keys, and Auto layout shows. Default true.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Double-click or Enter: the card's page or editor.

props.name: onPositionsChange
props.description:
Called with every card's position after a card is dragged (on release), moved with
Shift and an arrow key, or laid out by Auto layout. Persist it to keep the arrangement.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.description:
Called with the card id the person selects (click, Space, or Enter without `onOpen`),
or `null` when they clear it (Escape, or a click on empty canvas), and details whose
`item` is the card. The selected card's edges are drawn in the accent.

props.name: positions
props.description: Card positions, controlled. Cards missing from it are placed by the automatic layout.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected card's id, or null for none. Controlled while defined; leave it undefined to use `defaultSelectedId`.
